text:
The provided code has a critical flaw: it passes a string `'*.txt'` to `count_words`, which expects an iterable of file paths. This will not read all text files in a directory; it would attempt to open a file literally named `*.txt`. The solution lacks directory traversal (e.g., using `glob` or `os.walk`), does not normalize words (case, punctuation), and has no error handling. While it demonstrates basic use of `collections.Counter`, it fails to meet the core requirement.

Rating: [[3]]
